summary: Frontend-only regression + primary black-gap bug retest on homepage. PRIMARY BUG FIXED: no black/empty viewport frame exists between hero and West London (or anywhere between named scenes). Full-viewport heights, hero scroll-zoom, finale 4K image, and regression pages all verified. No console errors.

black_gap_hero_to_west.desktop_1440x900: PASS - fine-grained scroll scan from y=0 to y=1350 in 40px steps: at every step, the combined visible height of adjacent sections (hero+west or west+following section) equals the viewport height. E.g. y=1000: hero_vis=0, west_vis=800, remaining 100px covered by next section (FeaturedEditorial). No transparent/empty band observed.
black_gap_hero_to_west.mobile_390x844: PASS - same fine scan, no empty frame; e.g. y=1000: west_vis=688, remaining 156px covered by next section.

verification_details.hero_scroll_zoom: img transform scaled from matrix(1.06...) at scrollY=0 to matrix(1.206...) at scrollY=0.8*vh -- GSAP scrub zoom working.
verification_details.hero_content: Headline 'YOUR NEXT PROPERTY DECISION STARTS HERE.' present; hero-search form visible.

critical_code_review_comments: HomeHero uses id='hero' plus data-testid='home-hero'; other scenes only have data-testid. Testing spec referenced both id and testid interchangeably — fine, but consider consistent ids for anchor scrollTo(#west, #interior).
InteriorSection uses `-mt-[4vw]` diagonal overlap with WestLondon — visually fine, no gap observed, but be aware overlap subtracts from effective height (still >=0.95*vh).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug reproduction script: set scrollBehavior='auto', use window.scrollTo(0,y) in 40px increments from 0 to ~1.5*vh, compute (hero.visible + west.visible + nextSection.visible)/vh — expect >=1.0 at every step. If a scroll y produces a total <1.0 with no other section visible, black gap regression has returned.
rca of the issue: Not applicable this iteration — bug fix verified. Historical RCA: previous hero was 215vh with a 100vh sticky inner, leaving ~100vh empty parent bg between hero and next section. Current hero is a plain h-screen section with non-pinned GSAP scrub zoom, so DOM flow places WestLondon immediately after hero — eliminating the empty parent.
